none: PAS CAM-65FAF8: Roman Coin : A cut copper-alloy nummus of the House of Valentinian, AD 364-378.
contea di ritrovamento: City of Peterborough (Inghilterra e Galles)

A cut copper-alloy nummus of the House of Valentinian, AD 364-378 (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads [GLORIA RO]-MAN[ORVM]. Reverse shows Emperor advancing right, dragging captive and holding labarum. Mint is uncertain, AD 364-378. Obverse and obverse legend is illegible. Reverse fields and exergue are illegible. Die axis is uncertain. Weight is 0.82g, diameter is 16.1mm, thickness is 1.5mm
